kai: Heads-up 	6 units H100 from Wave-44 flagged at EU RoRo yard, manifest line mismatch. Could affect pool-eu-core RMA replacements.
monica: Which yard? ETA slip?
vendor-nova: Confirmed at Zeebrugge yard. Export docs show wrong commodity description. Options: 1) update manifest at yard (~6-12h + yard fee) or 2) divert to CDG air-hub and air-split for 4 priority units (+15% freight).
kai: Ops preference is minimal disruption to allocation. If yard fix <=12h we take it. If not, air-split 4 critical units to CDG.
vendor-nova: Pricing for air-split: freight +15%, handling $450/unit, insurance +0.7% declared. Yard correction: yard admin fee $780 flat.
ops-bot: Ticket VN-2024-9002 created 	"Zeebrugge manifest mismatch -> RMA H100 tranche". Assigned @kai, @monica, vendor-nova.
customs-bot: Note: ensure ECCN and serial list included when diverting to CDG. Air imports into FR need pre-clear slot Mon-Thu mornings.
monica: Vendor, please upload corrected manifest and serial CSV within 3h. If you recommend diversion, include AWBs and PO addendum to bill PO# 2024-9344.
vendor-nova: Will upload manifest correction within 2h. Provisional AWBs if diversion needed:
AWB: 340-7701001
AWB: 340-7701002
AWB: 340-7701003
AWB: 340-7701004

kai: Good. If AWBs posted ops will run the earmark command to pin units to pool-eu-core. Snippet: 
python ops/earmark.py --pool pool-eu-core --tag REDWOOD-RMA --awbs 340-7701001,340-7701002,340-7701003,340-7701004
monica: Also request vendor include 4 return RMA labels for flagged DOAs in the same manifest so we can do 1:1 swaps at arrival.
vendor-nova: Affirmative 	will include REDWOOD-RMA ref and RMA labels. Upload ETA ~2h.
kai: Thanks. We'll monitor. If yard fix finishes we cancel air-split and vendor refunds uplift. ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 6h follow-up VN-2024-9002
